checkpoints.description: [1/3] Planning and impact assessment for Aegean-E profile and AIKit integration

impact_assessment.why: Aegean-E is the GitHub profile repository for the account, housing the user's public profile and sponsorship config. It was missing local git tracking, AIKit memory, cold-start documentation, and Phase 4 delivery verification.
impact_assessment.benefits: Connects the profile repository to the AIKit cockpit, provides full cold-start and navigation quick references, adheres to AIKit hygiene and guidelines gates, and ensures clean delivery.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (profile markdown and metadata only); dependency: none (standard library / 0 deps); concurrency: single agent operation; state: additive .aikit memory files.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep profile content faithful to the rewritten version, add navigation and cold-start reference cleanly at the bottom, and run all built-in Phase 4 gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Integrated AIKit memory, tests, cold-start docs, and passed Phase 4 verification gates (checklists: passed)
